about: The exact commits Blockyland's data and asset scripts read from. Every script fetches through scripts/dataLock.mjs, so running one again reproduces the committed output. Move to newer data with: node scripts/dataLock.mjs --update <name>. tests/dataLock.test.js checks that every pin is a full commit SHA and that no script fetches from a branch.

minecraft-data.note: blocks, items, recipes (pc/1.21.4), foods (pc/1.21.1) and entityLoot (pc/1.20) are byte-identical to the cache src/blockHarvestData.js, src/mobLootData.js and src/foodData.js were generated from (2026-10-09).

minecraft-assets.note: 1,868 files under public/assets are byte-identical to files at this commit (public/assets/PROVENANCE.json).

mcmeta.note: The 1.21.4-data tag: the vanilla data pack as Minecraft 1.21.4's own data generator writes it.
